snippet.title: Meet Percy!  |  Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor – Out Now!
snippet.description:
Introducing Percy! 💚

Percy is a small green engine, who is also Thomas’ best friend! He may be cautious and easily flustered, but Percy is able to muster great bravery when the time calls. He is often treated as the youngest of the core characters.  

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of  Sodor is out  now on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation and Xbox via https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4

Nintendo Switch is coming soon.
